parts: Create a clean production cutout parts sheet for MICOFOLHA, the little golden lion tamarin living-kite creature from reference 1. Reference 2 is the approved Carcara handmade-paper finish, not anatomy. Preserve species: small lively orange golden lion tamarin monkey, circular orange folded-paper mane around a charcoal dark face, SMALL matte dark alert eyes with subtle warm brown separation (not large white sparkling eyes), tiny nose/mouth, round dark ears, orange squat body, dark charcoal hands and feet. Integrated canopy kite sail: cream/orange/deep teal leaf geometry, bamboo spars with cord ties, 1-2 tiny stitched paper repairs, two small hanging teal leaves. Long curled prehensile kite ribbon tail in orange/cream/deep teal angular paper panels. This is made of folded paper, not furry realistic animal carrying a separate kite. Bold dark ink contour, 2-3 flat color values per material, angular folds, no glossy 3D gradients. THREE QUARTER RIGHT facing, show near and smaller far eye, asymmetric limbs. Design nine coherent isolated pieces plus two alternative faces for articulated animation. Transparent background, no text, no grid. Arrange generously spaced in a strict THREE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS portrait sheet: row1 col1 orange torso ONLY (no head or limbs), col2 full neutral head with mane and small ears (no body), col3 entire structural leaf-patterned sail with bamboo, root lower-right; row2 col1 near arm with dark monkey hand pointing down-right root at top-left, col2 smaller far arm same perspective, col3 ENTIRE curled ribbon tail, open C curve sweeping left and down, attachment at upper-right; row3 col1 near bent leg with dark foot root at upper-right, col2 smaller far bent leg, col3 fierce head; row4 col1 hurt head (closed squeezed eyes), col2 happy head (closed happy eyes), col3 leave EMPTY. All three expression heads MUST be identical to neutral head in outer silhouette, ears, mane, size, tilt, nose/mouth placement, change ONLY eyes and eyebrows. Every limb has an intact covered root for overlap. Every piece complete, no cutoff, no touching adjacent pieces. Keep art attractive and readable at small game scale, matching the Carcara reference restraint, preserve Micofolha orange/darkface/teal-sail identity.
